title: Nostalgia Client
description: A modern edition with a touch of nostalgia
body:
**Do you sometimes feel nostalgic when you remember a certain period in your life, a moment in time?**

If you fondly remember those times while playing Minecraft Alpha versions, you can relive them with the **Nostalgia Client**. This modpack was created **to mimic the Alpha and** (soon) **Beta** versions of the game **in a way that other modpacks don't**. It's also **pre-configured** so all you have to do is _download, launch, and play_ just like you did in 2010.
With the [Moderner Beta](https://modrinth.com/mod/moderner-beta) mod, you can also restore the old world generators in the world creation settings, so you can once again explore the incredible landscapes created by the world generator.

**Remember to enable the Nostalgia Client Pack in the resource pack options to restore the classic textures.**
